palette.mood: Dark oxblood seafloor and stage, mint seafloor ears, gold for the machine's dots, chalk for the human-checked dots, coral only for the honest limits. Curious, wry, fair.
palette.divergence: Against 11-02 (midnight indigo, amber, teal, magenta), 11-01 (storm slate, sulphur), 10-31 (cream, cobalt, brass, vermilion) and 10-28 (green-black sonar abyss): this film is oxblood/wine (#2A0F1F sky, #4A1D2B ground) with mint and gold. No indigo, no teal, no green-black, no cream ground. Nearest value is 11-02's dark; resolved by moving every dark into the red-brown hue family.
palette.accent_licence: gold ONLY on machine-found dots, the Robot and the 3X numeral. Chalk ONLY on human-checked dots, analyst ink and paper. Mint ONLY on Bunk and the seafloor ears. Coral ONLY on the limit plates, the closing window and the waterline warning.

shape_language.grammar: ROUND against GRID: soft round domes, bulbs and dots (the ears, the quakes) against hard rectilinear catalogs, banners and the robot's cards
shape_language.why: The data is the soft living thing and the algorithm is the squared-off wrapper; the turn swaps the banner (hard) for the ear (round).
